title: Such load my strength shall never tire.

narrative.synopsis: [Sidenote: Creusa's ghost.] A trysting place near a ruined temple had already been appointed for his servants, and thither Æneas turned his steps. When he arrived there, he found many awaiting him, and counted them carefully to make sure none were missing.
